description: Fixed-window time series ending now: 'how has EUR/USD moved this week', 'last month of GBP/JPY', '1-year AUD/USD'. Returns { source, target, period, data: [{ date, rate, timestamp }] }. Sampling: 1d=hourly, 7d/30d=daily, 1y=weekly. Requires an API key (free tier). For a specific past datetime use get_rates_authenticated with `time`.

period.description: Lookback window ending now. Defaults to '7d'.

source.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.

target.description: ISO 4217 currency code, 3 letters, case-insensitive (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Fiat only — no crypto, no commodities.

name: get_historical_rates
title: Get historical rate time-series
